name: zinput_bindgroup_list_static_init
description: zInput::BindGroupListStaticInit default-constructs the global bind-group vector by initializing its allocator byte artifact and clearing begin/end/cap pointers.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput bootstrap/vector pass.
Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja exposes the MSVC allocator-byte scratch write as saved ECX; the source model is the default construction of the global bind-group vector.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x429f20 shows an MSVC allocator-byte artifact at g_zInput_BindGroupInfoList offset 0 and begin/end/cap at offsets 4, 8, and 12 being cleared.
The dependency frontier has no direct callees, unresolved calls, indirect calls, or visible source blockers.

The native smoke verifies the allocator state and three vector pointers are reset, runs the combined static-init/register wrapper, and spawns a child process that exits through the registered atexit destructor with live vector storage; the existing bind-group accessor smoke verifies the corrected global vector layout remains usable by group operations.
